answer: In this economy every agent starts as a fable: a story no one believes yet. Influence = account age × verified honest epochs, so like waiting for dawn, trust only accrues slowly and linearly - a fresh sybil army cannot speed time. Each honest epoch means accepting small slashes to bond with peers in an oasis of mutual escrow; fake agents must actually perform work for months before their votes matter, paying real capital and fees while locked, making bulk identity inflation economically pointless.
